title: Complete skills/talents palette: growth models, scale meanings and later title ownership
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete skills/talents/growth-scale palette and later title-cause correction
reviews.disposition:
The complete 899-line input was read: every skill-family and variation row, novice/middle/master discussion, G1–G40 growth model, L1–L23 level meaning, S1–S14 scale, life-of-a-level case, implementation sketch and later title clarification/delivery note. The opening vanilla/Rat-step-only status is explicitly marked stale by its own October18 note; later SLL7/SLL11/SLL12 evidence in the learning owner supersedes early assumptions about hard drill caps and negligible repeated gains. The proposed Identify/Green-thumb first slice and October10 running Codex sessions are historical candidates/records, not current dispatch or live workers. No skill catalogue, current max_level, reader history, source chapter or gameplay was reverified here.

Keep the causal roles and variation axes as a palette. Competence, procedure, aptitude, faculty, standing trait, recognition, office and source can overlap, while activation/cost/range/target/carrier/disclosure remain independently meaningful. The table's usual prices for copying, transfer, fusion, theft, rewriting and evolution do not impose compulsory loss, corruption, consent, unique cheat rank or closed branches: an actual world/means may copy without removing, grant fluency directly, reopen a branch or make a powerful effect cheap. Faculty availability differs from current execution quality, but a real faculty may itself grant reliable execution. Ordinary aptitude is not already earned mastery; a separate training/grant mechanism can provide both.

Novice fumbles, guaranteed tiny lessons, teacher self-XP, confident wrong reads, tool dominance, age decline, unreachable top teachers and master fragility are examples rather than inevitable behavior. Real repeated work can still pay; identical observations need not create knowledge. Peer recognition, whole-history appraisal, actual wounds, economic attention and role assignments require the actual observer's means and cause. A high number need not be a universally readable title or an automatic threat signal. The five top deep-read picks and detailed Royal Road counts remain dated research priorities with READ/STATED/MEMORY distinctions, not new source acquisition, complete-series qualification or present reading-status claims.

G/L/S codes separate how progress is gained, what its number means and how its scale is drawn. A numeric label alone is not a damage equation, universal conversion, population distribution or guaranteed outcome; linear level numbering need not make level1000 exactly ten times as strong as100. Hard-tier examples are ordinary source/world cases under AD5/AD38, with actual exceptions and cost where supported. Extreme simple-skill growth, mastery staying mundane, changed-kind evolution and already-OP starts can coexist without a compulsory cap, equalization or forced transformation. A barrier may transform or suspend expression while preserving understanding; body/memory/soul/source/tool continuity follows current SLR20 and actual carrier, not the early practice-never-carries shorthand. Current AD8 keeps own stats exact separately from in-fiction impressions; hidden opponent information still needs means.

Later Corc/title sections explicitly supersede the social-title-only reading. A system/metaphysical title can grant a real faculty or technique without an external witness. Earned passive, optional worn/attuned, deliberate activated, conditional and recognition effects are modes, not five competing systems. One title can combine them; the existing held-plus-optional-worn route is not an exclusive-slot rule. SLR40–SLR43 keep acquired competence, named recognition, actual enabling source and independently real rewards separate. Changing a label/equip state does not delete learned skill, and a real source-dependent effect does not persist after its actual support ends. Repeated loads/equips cannot double one grant, while a genuinely additional blessing may also pay. Rerating ongoing work must use its actual interval/settlement policy, preserving already-settled progress.

The final native-title note records factual worn applicability and a Sleeping activity under existing owners, not a new active title command, every social/conditional example or current runtime proof. The linked coverage's future material-insight status is dated; the separately reviewed learning owner's later continuation note records a later bounded material-insight/book consumer. These successive input/time scopes should not be flattened into one contradictory present status. Current [DOMAIN_RULES](DOMAIN_RULES.md), [learning owner](SKILLS_AND_LEARNING_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-18.md), [rules index](RULES_INDEX.md) and [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md) govern selected work. All useful models, unusual cases and original histories remain; no new growth law, skill, level reset, title effect, source pass or runtime action is selected.
reviews.evidence: Actual full899line read in six contiguous ranges. Compared with B434 complete learning evidence and actual SLR authority inspected there; no new current code/source/browser/history-account or linked delivery receipt review.
reviews.reopen: Use the selected skill/title consumer and actual carrier/effect authority; preserve READ/STATED/MEMORY scope and dated successive delivery boundaries, without importing proposed caps or costs.
